# optimizelycmp_content_type (Resource)

A structured content type. The API has no delete: destroying this resource **disables** the content type and removes it from Terraform state. The API marks these endpoints as experimental.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_user" "me" {
  email = "jane.doe@example.com"
}

resource "optimizelycmp_content_type" "article" {
  name           = "Article"
  description    = "A news article"
  component      = false
  acting_user_id = data.optimizelycmp_user.me.id

  expected_locales = ["en"]

  field_definitions_json = jsonencode([
    {
      core = {
        key                       = "headline"
        name                      = "Headline"
        field_type                = "text-field"
        is_list                   = false
        is_required               = true
        need_internationalization = true
      }
      validation_pattern = ""
      min_length         = 1
      max_length         = 120
    },
    {
      core = {
        key                       = "featured"
        name                      = "Featured"
        field_type                = "boolean"
        is_list                   = false
        is_required               = false
        need_internationalization = false
      }
      base_type = "boolean"
    },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acting_user_id` (String) ID of the CMP user recorded as creator/updater (the API requires one). Use the optimizelycmp_user data source. Changing it alone makes no API call.
- `component` (Boolean) Whether the type is a component (embedded in other content) rather than standalone content.
- `field_definitions_json` (String) JSON array of field definitions, exactly as the API defines them (use jsonencode). Changing it publishes a new content type version. Server-added defaults are ignored when checking for drift.
- `name` (String) Name of the content type.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the content type is disabled.
- `expected_locales` (Set of String) Locales the content is expected in. Changing it publishes a new version.
- `thumbnail_guid` (String) Thumbnail GUID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (ISO 8601 UTC).
- `id` (String) Content type GUID.
- `latest_version_id` (String) GUID of the latest version.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (ISO 8601 UTC).
